newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Man takes 34 people hostage on Seoul bus - police.
newsitem.headline: Man takes 34 people hostage on Seoul bus - police.

text.p: A knife-wielding man was holding 34 people hostage on a bus in South Korea's capital Seoul on Thursday, police said.
The domestic Yonhap news agency said the man, who commandeered the bus outside a government complex, was also carrying a home-made bomb. Police could not confirm that report.
Police sharpshooters were hiding behind a police vehicle near the public bus, witnesses said. The passengers, including at least two children, were huddled at the back of the bus.

"There are 34 people in the bus and the man holding them hostage has a knife," a police official told Reuters. The official identified the man as Kwon Shin-hong, 58, and said he took over the bus at around 2:30 p.m. (0530 GMT).
"We do not know what his demands are, although it appears to be something to do with his brother," the police official said.
The government complex in central Seoul houses several ministries.
